Independent Committee in relation to the  
Fire at Wang Fuk Court in Tai Po  

Witness Statement of LAM Ho-chun  

I, LAM Ho-chun, of New Territories East Division, New Territories North Command, Fire Services Department, 26-28 Yuen Wo Road, Shatin, N.T., do say as follows:-  

1. I am the Deputy Divisional Commander (New Territories East) of the Fire Services Department (“FSD”) of the Government of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region. I have joined the FSD for about 20 years since 2005 and was promoted to the present rank on 31 December 2023. My main responsibility is to assist Divisional Commander (New Territories East) in managing operations and administration of the New Territories East Division.  

2. I make this Witness Statement pursuant to Request 4 of the Independent Committee (“Committee”) in relation to the fire at Wang Fuk Court in Tai Po as set out in a letter from Messrs. Lo & Lo, Solicitors for the Committee, to the FSD dated 4 February 2026 (“4 February Letter”) in which specific questions were raised in paragraphs 1 to 10 and 16 (“Questions”). Save where otherwise appears, the facts deposed hereto are within my personal knowledge or are derived from office files and records and sources to which I have access and are true to the best of my knowledge, information and belief. Save as otherwise specified, this Witness Statement adopts the same abbreviations and nomenclature as in the 4 February Letter.
